description: This source file defines the MacroMenuRenderer class, which implements the MenuStringRenderer interface to render menu components using FreeMarker macros within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles rendering various menu elements like images, links, menu items, and menus by executing corresponding FreeMarker macros, applying themes, and managing macro execution environments.

classes.name: MacroMenuRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders menu components using FreeMarker macros, supporting dynamic inclusion, theme application, and external link handling within Apache OFBiz.

methods.name: createImageParameters
methods.description: Constructs a map of parameters required for rendering an image macro, resolving image source URLs based on request context.

methods.name: executeMacro
methods.description: Executes a FreeMarker macro with the given macro string, managing macro count and environment.

methods.name: executeMacro (overload)
methods.description: Constructs a macro call string with parameters and executes it.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the FreeMarker environment associated with a writer.

methods.name: isDisableIfEmpty
methods.description: Determines if a menu item should be disabled based on its disableIfEmpty attribute.

methods.name: isHideIfSelected
methods.description: Determines if a menu item should be hidden if it is selected.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperRows
methods.description: Renders each menu item in the menu.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image element using a FreeMarker macro.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders a hyperlink or button element, handling link attributes, confirmation messages, and optional images.

methods.name: renderMenuClose
methods.description: Ends the rendering of a menu, including macro invocation for closing macro and optional border handling.

methods.name: renderMenuItem
methods.description: Renders a single menu item, including label, link, styles, nested menus, and macro invocation.

methods.name: renderMenuOpen
methods.description: Starts the rendering of a menu, including macro invocation for opening macro and optional border handling.
